cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import subprocess, sys, json, time
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                     stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, bufsize=1)
reqs = [json.dumps({"op":"calibrate","profile":{"groups":2,"jitter_ps":[1,2],"measurements":[[0,1,2,4]]}}),
        json.dumps({"op":"plan","profile":{"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[0],"measurements":[]},
                    "fabric":{"n":1,"interval_ns":10,"slice_ns":10,"offset_ns":5,"drift_ppb":[0],"heat":[],
                              "anchors":[[0,0,1]],"links":[],"slices":[[]],"blackouts":[],"guards_ns":[0,1],"reconfig_ns":0}})]
for r in reqs:
    t0=time.time()
    p.stdin.write(r+"\n"); p.stdin.flush()
    line = p.stdout.readline()
    print('%.3fs' % (time.time()-t0), line.strip()[:200])
p.stdin.close()
p.wait(timeout=10)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'stderr', p.stderr.read()[:200])
PYEOF
